name: Doctrine of the Recording
body:
The power of stories is not perpetuated unless they are remembered, recorded, and passed on. The doctrine of recorded focuses on the recall and learning of stories.

Remembrance (Su)

After failing a Knowledge or Lore check, you can spend 1 point of faith to reroll the check. You can continue to spend faith to reroll until you succeed.

A Remembered Detail (Su)

You can remember lost details of the stories you tell to enhance their potency.

At 16th level, while you are using inspire courage, you can use a point of faith to grant a bonus to AC equal to the bonus granted by inspire courage and 2d8 temporary hit points. These bonuses affect those benefiting from inspire courage and last for 1d6 rounds or until the performance is ended. You can expend another faith point to maintain the benefits at the end of the duration.
